metadata.title: CollabPulse SaaS Production Architecture Spec
metadata.description: Enterprise multi-tenant topology matching Section 13 (Azure Front Door -> Container Apps / AKS -> PostgreSQL Flexible / Redis / Blob / Key Vault)

topology.edge: Azure Front Door (WAF, TLS termination, CDN for Angular assets)
topology.ingress: Container App Managed Environment with Internal Ingress
compute: API (ASP.NET Core 8 Web API, stateless, CQRS pipeline)
Worker (Background Worker for Jobs, Notifications, Webhooks)

data.relational: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server (Zone redundant, 35-day PITR)
data.cache_realtime: Azure Cache for Redis (Premium, SignalR backplane, session state)
data.object_storage: Azure Blob Storage (ZRS, private containers, SAS short-lived tokens)

security.secrets: Azure Key Vault with Managed Identity CSI driver

observability.telemetry: Azure Application Insights & Log Analytics Workspace
